title: ClaudeMeter status file
description: Written by the ClaudeMeter companion to <data folder>/status.json whenever the figures change. Times are epoch milliseconds unless the name ends in Iso. New fields may be added without the schema number changing; existing ones keep their meaning.

schema.description: Goes up only for a change that would break a reader.

updatedAt.description: When this file was written. Compare with the clock to tell whether it is stale: nothing updates it while the browser is closed.

plan.description: claude.ai plan usage, as the extension last read it.

fetchedAt.description: When the extension last heard from claude.ai.

tier.description: The plan's name, when claude.ai reports one.

hidden.description: True while privacy mode is on in the browser; session, weekly and claudeCode are then empty.

session.description: The 5-hour session; null when unknown or hidden.

weekly.description: One entry per weekly limit: "All models", and model-specific ones such as "Opus".

thresholds.description: The percentages at which the user has meters turn amber and red.

claudeCode.description: A digest of Claude Code usage from its local logs; null until the logs have been read, or while hidden. Costs are US dollars at API list prices, not money charged.

session.description: The current 5-hour window; null when none is open.

cacheHitRate.description: Share of the week's prompt tokens served from the prompt cache, 0 to 1.

line.description: The plan usage as one line, e.g. "5h 62% · wk 71%" — also the whole of status.txt.

tokens.description: Input, output and cached tokens together.
